name: Ōtaki (Chiba, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ōtaki town emblem in white: a ring with five spokes enclosing a ring, like a stylised flower.
history: Municipal flag of Ōtaki, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 January 1958.

features.role: Ōtaki town emblem — a ring with five spokes enclosing a ring, like a stylised flower
